integration_verified.description: All 5 verification scenarios in plan.md's Verification section pass against the live broker + both clients. Scenario 2 (persistence) verified even more strongly than specified: lease survived a full host reboot, not just a broker container restart. Scenario 3 (sweeper reclaim) verified via the same reboot-orphaned lease rather than podman kill -- identical code path (no heartbeat within LEASE_TTL_SECONDS). Scenario 4 (fairness/queueing) verified against the live broker with synthetic large-sized concurrent callers rather than literally through both real clients, since current ambient GPU load left insufficient headroom to construct genuine contention at the real clients' actual request sizes (Flux2Klein9B capped at 8192MB, Needle flat 768MB).

status_dashboard_tui.description: tools/dashboard.py (Assist/TODO.md section 8): rich-based read-only terminal client polls GET /status and GET /health, renders live budget/reserved/ollama/nvidia_smi_used/free-headroom state and the leases table (caller, lease id, age since last heartbeat), and appends each snapshot to a JSONL log (data/dashboard_history.jsonl) for a usage-over-time sparkline view. Verified against a second, isolated GpuBroker instance (docker-compose.test.yml, port 8798, no GPU device, mocked nvidia-smi) exercising acquire/heartbeat/release, and read-only against the live broker for display. tests/test_dashboard.py (26 tests) covers log round-trip/trim/skip-corrupt, lease-age tracking, sparkline/age formatting, mocked HTTP polling, and a static scan proving the module never calls .post( or references a mutating endpoint or GPU_BROKER_ADMIN_TOKEN.

priority_preemption_and_watchdog.description: server.py (Assist/TODO.md section 8): tier-based (P0-P3) fairness preemption with anti-starvation aging capped at next-tier parity and an incumbency bonus enforced strictly below one tier-step by a startup assertion (_validate_priority_config), signaled cooperatively via heartbeat's new preempt/reason fields with a self-evict grace period; plus an independent broken-client watchdog (heartbeat staleness, hardened, and a new 30-minute total-lease-age backstop) that force-kills a lease's self-reported pid after cross-checking it against a fresh compute-apps listing to avoid signaling a reused pid, shares its kill sequence with admin_clear via _kill_targets_with_grace, and delivers a one-shot force-termination notice on the caller's next acquire grant. tests/test_priority_watchdog.py (38 tests, plus tests/conftest.py extracting shared fixtures) covers aging/capping, non-preemptible exclusion, the incumbency-bonus assertion, PID-reuse avoidance, both watchdog triggers independently reaching the kill sequence, and one-shot notification delivery/clearing. Verified live end-to-end against the isolated docker-compose.test.yml instance (fast timing overrides): observed real preemption flagging, grace-expiry watchdog reclaim, waiter admission, notification delivery, and the startup assertion actually refusing to boot with an invalid GPU_BROKER_INCUMBENCY_BONUS.

game_deny_all.description: Broker returns 503 with Retry-After to every new acquire while unmanaged GPU load is heavy or a Steam Proton game runs. Detects Proton before each acquire and blocks for 30 minutes after exit, with persisted cooldown. Proxy and Flux honor denials without failing open. Verified with a synthetic process inside a throwaway broker.

freetoken_idle_release.description: FreeToken front proxy loads on first request and stops ft serve after 60 seconds idle before releasing its lease. Live requests, idle unload, and stop-with-model-loaded verified.
